context_requirements: Expression of the relevant transporter or carbonic anhydrase target (e.g., SLC12A1/SLC12A3, ATP1A1, CA2/CA9/CA12, KCNMA1)
Intact ion homeostasis and volume-regulation machinery
For carbonic anhydrase inhibition, dependence on CA-mediated pH regulation or bicarbonate flux
For ATP1A1 inhibition, dependence on Na+/K+-ATPase activity for survival
falsifiers: No consistent transcriptional response across the nine cell lines at 6 h or 24 h
Absence of cholesterol-synthesis gene repression at 24 h
Absence of any stress-response signature (ATF4/DDIT3, NRF2, or UPR) at 24 h
Strong proliferation or cell-cycle signature changes at 6 h

changes: Removed cholesterol-synthesis genes (HMGCR, HMGCS1, FDFT1, NSDHL, EBP, INSIG1, ACAT2) from proximal_down and late_down: no established mechanism links sodium/potassium/chloride transporter or carbonic anhydrase inhibition to SREBP/cholesterol pathway repression.

Removed duplicate TRIB3, DDIT4, HMOX1, SQSTM1, ATF5, CEBPD, NFKBIA, IER3, ZFP36, DUSP4, FOS, JUN from late_up because they already appear in proximal_up; a gene must not appear in both an up and a down list of the same time, and these are immediate-early/stress genes expected at 6 h rather than a separate late set.

Kept proximal_up stress genes (FOS, JUN, EGR1, ATF5, DDIT4, TRIB3, HMOX1, SQSTM1, NFKBIA/B/E, IER3, ZFP36, CEBPD, DUSP4) as directionally plausible for ion imbalance/ATP1A1 inhibition, but flagged them as generic stress rather than transporter-specific.
Kept late_up CDKN1A, GADD45A, GADD45B as plausible secondary growth-arrest response to sustained ion/pH stress.
No evidence citations were provided, so evidence list remains empty.
